description:
The site's deploy link gate found 10 internal links whose fragment does not exist on the target page. All 10 are broken on the live site too, so they predate the site split; they were added to the site repo's inventory/known-broken-links.json so the gate does not block deploys on existing breakage.

- Site repo: the landing page links /docs/usage/installation.html#no-docker-required; the page has no such heading id.
- Core docs: the CLI reference index (/docs/reference/cli/) links fragments that the results, tuning and utilities pages do not have: results.html#compare, #export, #results; tuning.html#tuning-dataframe, #tuning-init; utilities.html#benchmarks, #check-deps, #profile, #validate.

Fix the links or add the anchors, then remove the 10 entries from inventory/known-broken-links.json.
